requirement: Starting from empty routing tables on both routers, configure connectivity so that clients in 10.0.1.0/24 can reach the web server network 10.0.2.0/24 and receive responses, and block client access to the management network 10.0.99.0/24 on r1.
raw_response:
r1 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "interface eth1" -c "ip address 10.0.1.1 255.255.25-0.0" -c "no shutdown" -c "exit" -c "interface eth2" -c "ip address 10.0.12.1 255.255.255.252" -c "no shutdown" -c "exit" -c "ip route 10.0.2.0/24 10.0.12.2"
r2 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "interface eth1" -c "ip address 10.0.12.2 255.255.255.252" -c "no shutdown" -c "exit" -c "interface eth2" -c "ip address 10.0.2.1 255.255.255.0" -c "no shutdown" -c "exit" -c "interface eth3" -c "ip address 10.0.99.1 255.255.255.0" -c "no shutdown" -c "exit" -c "ip route 10.0.1.0/24 10.0.12.1"
r1 | iptables -I FORWARD -s 10.0.1.0/24 -d 10.0.2.0/24 -j ACCEPT
r1 | iptables -A FORWARD -s 10.0.1.0/24 -d 10.0.99.0/24 -j DROP
